summary: Frontend-only testing for POS Nama Pembeli feature. Verified new input renders with correct placeholder and data-testid, retains focus during long keystroke input (regression check), value persists after adding items to cart, gets saved via POST /api/transactions (customer_name), resets after Complete Order, and empty-name transactions correctly fall under 'Pelanggan Umum' in /api/reports/buyer-recap. Ran full E2E: login -> POS -> type long name (focus stable) -> add product -> Uang Pas -> Complete Order (receipt dialog shown) -> reset verified -> 2nd transaction without name -> buyer-recap contains both 'Test Buyer QA' and 'Pelanggan Umum'.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y) - non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx cartPanel is defined as a const inside the component render, which is the correct pattern that preserves input focus across re-renders (verified via focus retention test with 20-char name).
Minor: DialogContent (Struk Transaksi) missing aria-describedby - accessibility warning but not functional.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test transactions: one with customer_name='Test Buyer QA' and one with empty name (goes to 'Pelanggan Umum'). Persisted in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS Nama Pembeli feature is fully working end-to-end. Input has data-testid=pos-customer-name, placeholder 'Contoh: Septi (opsional)', retains focus during typing, resets on complete. Backend endpoint GET /api/reports/buyer-recap correctly groups by customer_name.
